resources.string: Notices which app is in front so BlackOut can deepen the dark greys of apps that overlays cannot theme, and reads the colour under the colour bar. It only looks at where text and images are, so they stay bright. Nothing is stored or sent.
BlackOut: turns the dark greys of the apps you enable into pure black (AMOLED). Works even when an app hides its colour names. Nothing leaves the phone.
